title: RecoveryAI MCP Tool Catalog
description: Standard JSON-RPC 2.0 tool definitions exposed by RecoveryAI native engine

tools.name: list_physical_drives
tools.description: Enumerates all connected physical drives, USB flash drives, and external disk enclosures. Identifies drive numbers, models, bus types (USB/SCSI/NVMe), and highlights external disks suitable for recovery.

returns.drives: array of { device_id, drive_number, target_path, model, interface_type, media_type, size_bytes, size_formatted, is_external, recommendation }

tools.name: open_recovery_session
tools.description: Opens a forensic recovery session for a physical disk (\\.\PhysicalDriveX) or raw disk image (.img, .dd). Enforces 100% read-only access and initializes in-memory virtual overlay.

tools.name: scan_disk_topology
tools.description: Scans LBA 0..33 for MBR/GPT partition tables and scans backup GPT header at the end of the disk.

returns.partitions: array of { index, partition_type, start_lba, end_lba, total_sectors, filesystem_hint }

tools.name: inspect_sector_structure
tools.description: Inspects raw hex/ASCII content and Shannon entropy of specified sector range. Highlights known magic signatures (0x55AA, NTFS, FAT32, etc.).

tools.name: scan_filesystem_journals
tools.description: Deep parses filesystem metadata (NTFS $MFT, $UsnJrnl, $LogFile or FAT32/exFAT FAT table and root directories) to discover deleted files and unallocated clusters.

returns.recoverable_files: array of { id, name, size, parent_path, is_contiguous, allocated }

tools.name: start_async_disk_job
tools.description: Starts a long-running background forensic job (SIMD magic carver, fragment prefilter, or ddrescue clone). Returns job_id immediately for polling.

params.description: Job specific parameters (e.g. target_file_types, start_lba, end_lba, destination_image)

tools.name: poll_async_job
tools.description: Polls the status, progress percentage, and results of an ongoing background forensic job.

tools.name: virtual_patch_and_verify
tools.description: Applies an in-memory hex patch to the RAM Copy-on-Write overlay and verifies if filesystems/partitions can now mount or parse cleanly. ZERO physical disk modification.

patch_hex.description: Hexadecimal string representing the replacement sector data

tools.name: extract_recovered_data
tools.description: Extracts recovered files, partitions, or carved cluster streams to a secure physical destination directory on a different volume.
